t: Brenner Thick Bleach 1Ltr is a professional-grade thick bleach designed to clean and deodorise drains. This powerful formula clears stubborn blockages, removes tough stains, and eliminates foul odours from pipework. It is ideal for commercial plumbers, facility managers, and busy caretakers maintaining high-traffic washrooms. The thick liquid clings to surfaces for longer contact time, ensuring deep sanitisation and leaving a fresh finish. Provides a reliable, ready-to-use solution for keeping trade plugholes clear and free-flowing.
